result.summary: Found one clear visual defect: the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card. The clipped carousel item at the right edge and the partially visible card at the bottom are intentional and were not reported.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ("25–35 min") overlaps the delivery fee text ("€0 delivery"), making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and fee on separate lines or in separate containers, or add spacing so they do not share the same position. Check the text container's width and wrapping behavior.
